tools.name: search_facilities
tools.description: Find certified US skilled nursing facilities near an address or in a city. Filter by ownership type, star rating, abuse flag, high-performing icon, or Special Focus status. Returns ownership, ratings, nurse hours (HPRD), nurse/RN turnover, weighted inspection score, beds, fines, straight-line distance_miles, and map links. distance_miles is straight-line miles, not drive time. An address is geocoded on the server.

address.description: Street address with city and state, or a street and ZIP. Geocoded by the Census Bureau as the distance origin. A city, place name, or ZIP alone will not match.

abuse_icon.description: CMS abuse icon filter. Y/yes/true/1 keeps only flagged homes; other values keep homes without the flag.

icon_hi_perf.description: CMS high-performing icon (Risk-Based Survey eligibility). Y/yes/true/1 keeps only homes with the icon; other values keep homes without it. Point-in-time, not a permanent award.

sffstatus.description: When truthy, keep only Special Focus Facility or candidate homes (non-empty sffstatus).

ownership.description: Ownership type from ProviderInfo.ownership. Case-insensitive. Prefixes For profit, Non profit, and Government match that kind. Exact labels look like "For profit - Limited Liability company".

sort.description: Sort key: overall_rating (default, desc), survey_rating, quality_rating, staffing_rating, distance (asc, straight-line miles), tothrd or total_nurse_hours (desc), totalnursingstaffturnover or nurse_turnover (asc), weighted_all_cycles_score or survey_score (asc). Unknown values fall back to overall_rating.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: search_facilities_by_ownership
tools.description: Find certified US nursing homes by ownership type (ProviderInfo.ownership). The result rows match a facility search. Combine with state, city, ZIP, or address.

ownership.description: CMS ownership type. Case-insensitive. Prefixes For profit, Non profit, and Government match that kind. Exact values from list_distinct_values field=ownership, e.g. "For profit - Limited Liability company".

address.description: Street address with city and state, or a street and ZIP. Geocoded by the Census Bureau as the distance origin. A city, place name, or ZIP alone will not match.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: summarize_facilities
tools.description: Aggregate numeric ProviderInfo fields (n, mean, min, max; optional median) across certified nursing homes. Facility-equal means, not bed-weighted. Missing values are excluded per metric. Not causal. A named home still needs a single-facility lookup.

metrics.description: Metric keys: tothrd, rnhrd, weekend_tothrd, weekend_rnhrd, totalnursingstaffturnover, registerednurseturnover, weighted_all_cycles_score, overall_rating, survey_rating, staffing_rating, quality_rating, bedcert, restot, fine_tot, fine_cnt, occupancy (and documented synonyms).

group_by.description: Omit for one national (or filter-scoped) row per metric. ownership_kind is Government | For profit | Non profit.

ownership.description: CMS ownership type. Prefixes For profit, Non profit, and Government match that kind. Applied before aggregation.

icon_hi_perf.description: CMS high-performing icon. Y keeps homes currently eligible for a Risk-Based Survey.

include_median.description: When true, each stats object also includes median. Default false.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: compare_facilities
tools.description: Compare up to 25 certified skilled nursing facilities by CMS CCN or web slug. Returns ratings, nurse hours, turnover, inspection score, beds, fines, and map links in one table.

ids.description: CMS CCNs (provnum) or web slugs. Max 25.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: get_facility_changes
tools.description: Monitor one skilled nursing facility across two CMS monthly files. Defaults to latest vs the prior snapshot. Returns field-level diffs for stars, nurse hours, turnover, inspection score, abuse icon, high-performing icon, fines, and occupancy. Care Compare shows this month only — rerun after the next file.

from.description: Earlier filedate YYYY-MM-DD. Omit to use the snapshot before to.

to.description: Later filedate. Omit to use the latest CMS file.

tools.name: get_facility
tools.description: Get one certified skilled nursing facility by CMS CCN (provnum) or web slug. Returns the same decision fields as search_facilities: ratings, nurse hours (HPRD), nurse/RN turnover, weighted inspection score, beds, fines, abuse/SFF flags, and maps deep-links. Use data_as_of as the CMS vintage; do not invent ratings or hours that are missing. Defaults to the latest monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates for a prior month.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: get_facility_ownership
tools.description: Get CMS ownership records for one facility — who owns or manages the building. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: search_owners
tools.description: Search nursing-home owners by name. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: get_owner
tools.description: Get an owner portfolio by web_owner slug, including facility names, locations, and overall stars. Defaults to the latest CMS monthly snapshot; pass filedate from list_file_dates to query a prior month.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: list_file_dates
tools.description: List CMS monthly snapshot dates available in the database (newest first), plus the current filedate and known unpublished months. Use a returned date as filedate on other tools to retrieve a prior month instead of the latest data.

tools.name: list_distinct_values
tools.description: List distinct ProviderInfo values and counts for a field. Omit field to see the catalog. ownership returns the ownership labels. city requires state.

field.description: ProviderInfo field. Omit to list allowed fields. ownership returns the ownership labels.

state.description: Optional two-letter state. Required when field=city.

filedate.description: Optional monthly snapshot (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM). Defaults to the latest loaded file.

tools.name: get_data_freshness
tools.description: Latest source dataset dates and row counts for the nursing-home files.
